### [Coal India Production Up 19% Post-Monsoon](https://news.google.?oc=5) ⭐️ 7.0/10

Coal India&\#x27;s production increased 19% as mining operations recovered following the monsoon season, which typically causes temporary disruptions.

rss · GoogleNews El Nino/monsoon · Nov 1, 16:36

**「Background」** Monsoon season significantly impacts coal mining operations in India, particularly in major producing regions like Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha which experience heavy seasonal rainfall.

**「Coal Supply Impact」** Coal India&\#x27;s 19% production recovery after monsoon slump increases domestic supply, potentially reducing India&\#x27;s coal import demand and affecting regional coal prices.

### [Banks Prepare for El Nino Economic Impact](https://news.google.?oc=5) ⭐️ 5.0/10

Banks are considering loan holidays and debt relief measures as they brace for potential economic disruptions from El Nino weather patterns, which could affect agricultural sectors and loan repayments.

rss · GoogleNews El Nino/monsoon · Nov 2, 04:53

**「Background」** El Nino is a global weather pattern that typically reduces agricultural yields, with past events causing global corn yields to drop 2.3% and wheat yields 1.4%, potentially leading to economic impacts that outlast the weather itself due to harvest losses and supply chain disruptions.

**「Impact」** Farmers and agricultural businesses may benefit from debt relief, while banks face potential losses from increased loan defaults in affected regions.
